Step 3. Consider the trace-class operator \(Q_{01330013}\) acting on the homogeneous space. By the trace-class decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01330013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the real convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
